d: Long, flowing dark chocolate brown hair with straight bangs and a high side ponytail. Sharp, glowing crimson eyes with a focused expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender, athletic build wearing a futuristic form-fitting suit composed of a white chest panel, dark charcoal grey sleeves and leggings, and a black utility belt with orange accents. Holding a massive, mechanical black greatsword featuring a glowing red vertical line and the text "FENRIR 09" on the blade.
